goal: Protect the completed pipeline detail route family with focused component and router regressions for current routes, status/cancellation variants, permissions, actions, tabs, empty/error states, and responsive containment.
non_goals: Do not change production components other than the verified PipelineWrapper cancellation-parameter correction, router definitions, APIs, stores, backend behavior, persistence, dependencies, authentication, permission calculation, locales, or the approved prototype.
Do not add routes, query parameters, status/event variants, permissions, actions, fields, fixtures, compatibility behavior, or prototype-only data.
Do not perform task 3.5 consolidated browser, dark/light theme, locale, screenshot, or sensory evidence.
expected_evidence: Focused router/component tests covering named routes, tabs/counts, killed cancellation context, permissions/actions, step routing, empty/error states, and local responsive containment.
Full frontend Vitest, targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff output.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent spec and quality reviews that keep task 3.5 sensory evidence open.
unsafe_assumptions: Rendered tabs do not prove named route resolution or route parameter shape.
Status variants do not prove all cancel_info branches.
Workflow PID, step PID, invalid step ID, and log-close selection behavior are distinct contracts.
Structural containment assertions are not browser no-overflow evidence.
stop_condition: Stop if a required fix needs any production file other than PipelineWrapper.vue, a new router/API/store/backend/dependency/permission contract, prototype-only data, task 3.5 sensory evidence, or duplicated shared test infrastructure.
